{{Top}}
'''Chambers''' was a card game dating back to the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial era]], based on an ancient children's question that asked "If so-and-so fought so-and-so, who would win?" In [[43 ABY]], a game of Chambers was played between [[Haydnat Treen]], [[Merratt Jaxton]], [[Fost Bramsin]], and [[Drikl Lecersen]].

==Rules==
When a player tossed a card onto the gaming table, it would be pitted against the card on its left in hypothetical combat taking place in a private chamber. When a player's card defeated another card in combat, the player was awarded a "[[Death/Legends|kill]]." The stronger card always won, but a number of factors determined the value of a card, including strength, will, chance, and the color of the card. A blue card trumped a white card, a red card trumped a blue card, and a black card trumped a red card. The beginning of each round of play&mdash;or "hand"&mdash;was called "launch." Betting could be matched or raised by each player.<ref name="Backlash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref>

Cards in a Chambers deck included Courtesans, [[Droideka/Legends|Destroyer Droids]], [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Imperial Guardsmen]], [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Trooper Captains]], [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone Trooper]] Privates, [[Vizier/Legends|Viziers]], and [[Emperor/Legends|Emperors]], all of which came in a variety of colors. A White Clone Trooper Private was among the lowest cards in the deck, while the Black Emperor was the most powerful card and trumped all others. A Blue Vizier was a powerful card, but had a lower Will value than a Red Courtesan.<ref name="Backlash" />

==History==
A [[Gambling/Legends|high-stakes]] game of chambers was played in [[43 ABY]] between [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Drikl Lecersen]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Haydnat Treen]] of [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Merratt Jaxton]] of [[Galactic Alliance Starfighter Command]], and Senator [[Fost Bramsin]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] at the [[Gleaming Fortunes Casino]] on Coruscant, as the four conspired to overthrow [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].<ref name="Backlash" />
